Introduction

Stellar Sugar was an upcoming seven-member girl group formed through the survival show, Stellar Sugar. As of May 22, 2025, the lineup consists of Jiin and Karuna (former PoshGirls members), Unia, Roa (Someilsang and former X:IN member), and Moana (former Girls Planet 999 and The Entertainer contestant).

While the top five contestants secured their debut spots on May 22, the last two spots in the group are set to be announced during the live finale on the 24th. Currently four contestants (former Universe Ticket contestant Yona, Yin, Rian, and Juney) are contenders for the debut spots.

Karuna announced that the group’s debut was cancelled on September 17, 2025, and three members became members of I-CODE.
